{{Top|leg}}
'''Sarvin''' was an extremely adhesive substance biologically produced from pores in the feet and hands of the sapient species, [[Jiivahar]]. It adhered to all but the slickest surfaces and was a great boon to the Jiivahar's remarkable climbing talents, as well as their ability to grip onto things or persons. Jiivahar naturally cleaned themselves of their sarvin by controlled perspiration.
